gaps.sentence: ___ , the fire brigade arrived within minutes (LUCKY).
gaps.hint: sentence adverb needed at the start (-ly)
gaps.explanation: A sentence adverb comments on the whole statement: Luckily. The adjective 'lucky' cannot start the sentence.

gaps.sentence: The government's ___ (DECIDE) to raise taxes was criticized.
gaps.explanation: After 'The government's' a noun is needed: decision (-sion noun); 'decisive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: He answered all the questions with great ___ (CONFIDENT).
gaps.explanation: 'Great' needs a noun: confidence. 'Confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The company is a major ___ (EMPLOY) in the region.
gaps.hint: the company gives jobs — it is the one who employs
gaps.explanation: An employer gives work; an employee receives it. The sentence is about the company.

gaps.sentence: We must ___ our efforts to finish on time (STRONG).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -en forms the verb: strengthen. A base verb follows 'must'.

gaps.sentence: The treaty will strengthen economic ___ between the two countries (COOPERATE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is followed by a noun: cooperation (-tion noun).

gaps.sentence: He is one of the best ___ (SCIENCE) in the field.
gaps.hint: plural person needed after 'one of the best'
gaps.explanation: 'One of the best' is followed by a plural noun for people: scientists.

gaps.sentence: The vaccine is still awaiting official ___ (APPROVE).
gaps.explanation: 'Official approval' — the noun form follows the adjective.
